design.calibration: Fit both streams' joint Gaussian readout per state on repeat 0. Require three neighbors on each side with agreeing full-bin threshold labels, leaving the center unused for assigning the calibration state.
design.nomination: In each direction use the nomination stream alone. An isolated nomination is one away label surrounded by three starting labels on each side. For the comparison group use the center of exactly three away labels with three starting labels on each side of the excursion.
design.corroboration: Report both the confirmation stream's midpoint label and its conditional log likelihood ratio for the away versus starting state given the nomination stream's actual center value. Also count whether the full-bin HMM retained the nominated excursion, without using it to select nominations.
design.boundary: Both streams share one acquisition and may have correlated noise or mixed states inside a bin. Corroboration is conditional on calibration and does not measure the latent state directly.
